title: Core: AS2 string methods (replace, split, match)
description: Test compilation of string prototype methods used heavily in Flash 8 AS2: s.replace(pattern, replacement), s.replace(/re/, 'repl'), s.split(delimiter), s.match(/pattern/), s.search(/pattern/). Verify ActionCallMethod (0x52) for each. Also test: s.length (ActionGetMember 0x4f), s.charAt(n), s.indexOf(sub), s + other (ActionAdd2). Test string with special chars: \n, \t, Unicode.
